title: Green Cat Wizard
description: A vibrant green cat with glowing yellow eyes leaps through the air holding an open spellbook in its mouth. The cat wears a red collar with a glowing blue crystal and is surrounded by magical green energy, floating books, potion bottles, and bats inside a glowing triangular portal with radiating light beams.
prompt: A dynamic fantasy scene of a bright green cat with luminous yellow eyes leaping forward through the air, clutching an open ancient spellbook in its jaws. The cat wears a red collar with a glowing blue crystal pendant. It is surrounded by floating magical books, potion vials, and bats. The cat emerges from a large glowing blue triangular portal with radiating golden light beams and swirling green magical energy against a dramatic purple and pink sky.
